title: 第六十四章 赤地千里逢大旱 饿殍遍野动悲肠第六十三章 乡关骤起干戈乱 尘世再逢兵灾难
content_zh:
诗曰：
烽烟才歇路漫漫，又遇乾坤燥气寒。
万顷良田生裂土，千家饥馁断炊烟。
众人离了下马村，向西迤逦而行。一路之上，渐觉地气燥热，风卷尘土，不见半分雨露。先前道旁尚有青苗野草、溪流潺潺，越往前行，草木愈发枯黄，河沟日渐干涸。天地之间，一片闷热潮浊，举目望去，远山失翠，平川泛黄，隐隐透出一派肃杀荒寂之气。
何日抬手拭去额间细尘，望着遍野枯景，蹙眉吟道：
“别却兵戈路向西，晴光连日少云霓。
田畴不见青青色，已觉灾氛覆野堤。
方才历经战火，本盼乡野稍安，谁想又逢异状，这般燥热久晴，恐是天大旱降临了。”
白洁驻足俯身，伸手抚过脚下干裂的土地，泥土坚硬如石，一捻便化作飞灰，轻声诵道：
“土裂千纹草不生，长河断流水声倾。
苍天久吝甘霖降，万户苍生怎聊生？
兵祸伤人，尚有余地辗转；天灾降世，天地万物同受熬煎。江河枯竭，田地龟裂，五谷绝收，便是坐拥金银，也难换一口吃食。此劫比起刀兵，更是凶险万分。”
何月闭目凝神，静察天地气机，片刻后睁开双眼，神色愈发凝重：“方圆数百里，云气断绝，雨脉全消，足足数月未有滴雨。旱情已深，周遭村落必是粮尽水竭，苦不堪言。”
公孙离遥望前方连绵荒村，往日袅袅炊烟尽数不见，轻叹道：
“曾居云阙览山河，满目青葱入眼多。
今踏尘途逢旱魃，方知造化亦偏颇。
人祸尚可人力相扶，天灾乃是天地变数。我等封却神通，不能呼风唤雨、布云施雨，唯有以凡身相伴，共历饥馑之苦。”
花月步道：“红尘诸劫，人心、兵戈之后，便是饥馑天灾。五谷为养，水火为生，一旦二者俱绝，黎民便陷入绝境。此关炼的是悲悯之心，见众生饿殍遍野，若道心不动、恻隐全无，大道终究难臻圆满。”
黄鼬妖缩在何年肩头，小鼻子嗅了嗅干燥的风，怯生生道：“往日山间尚有清泉野果，如今草木都枯了，连小虫都不见踪影。这般光景，百姓可怎么活下去呀？”
何年微微颔首，目光沉凝，缓声言道：“天有四时，亦有灾祥。水旱风雷，皆是天地轮回定数。我等自封圣力，不违天道秩序，不可强行施雨、逆转乾坤。但见饥困之人，当尽力相扶，能济一餐便济一餐，能渡一人便渡一人。走吧，往前看看。”

众人举步再行，不过数里，眼前景象更是触目惊心。
但见：
赤地绵延万里黄，田坼深沟似刀伤。
溪河见底鱼虾尽，老树枯枝叶尽亡。
村舍萧条门半掩，沿途饿殍卧道旁。
声声啼泣随风至，满目凄凉断客肠。
官道两侧，良田尽数龟裂，沟壑纵横，深可嵌足。往日碧波荡漾的河道，如今只剩光秃秃的河床，乱石裸露，滴水无存。道旁古树枝干焦枯，半点绿意也无。一座座村落静悄悄的，少有行人走动，偶有几声微弱啼哭，随风飘散，更显荒寂。
行至一处名为苦水村的庄落村口，远远便见一群面黄肌瘦的乡民，三三两两瘫坐门前。个个衣衫褴褛，面色蜡黄，眼窝深陷，四肢枯瘦如柴，连起身行走的力气都已不足。
一名白发老妪扶着门框，气息奄奄，怀中抱着一名瘦得只剩皮包骨的孩童，孩童双目紧闭，气若游丝，已然饿晕过去。
“水……水……”孩童微弱的呢喃，听得人心头发紧。
老妪老泪纵横，哽咽自语：“天杀的大旱啊……数月不下雨，井也干了，粮也绝了，一家人数日未曾进食，孙儿怕是撑不住了……”
旁边几名壮年汉子，往日能耕能种，如今也瘫在地上，有气无力，望着干裂的田地连连长叹，眼中满是绝望。
“往年再苦，好歹有收成，如今颗粒无收，存粮早已吃尽。家中老幼，日日忍饥挨饿，再熬下去，怕是全村人都要埋在这黄土里了。”
“想逃荒，可四方皆是大旱，逃到何处都是一样。走不动，也逃不开，只能在这里等死啊……”
黄鼬妖看得眼圈发红，小爪子捂住嘴巴：“太可怜了……连一口水、一口粮都没有，这日子比在魔渊受苦还要难熬。仙师，我们快想想办法！”
何日大步上前，蹲下身查看那名昏迷的孩童，又看向周遭饥民，开口叹道：
“沃土良田化土沙，苍生饿馁乱如麻。
苍天不洒三分雨，枉教黎庶丧岁华。
诸位乡亲，此地周遭可有残存水源、些许野物？坐以待毙终究不是办法。”
一名壮年汉子缓缓摇头，声音沙哑：“客官有所不知，方圆数十里，井干河绝，哪里还有活水？山野草木枯焦，飞禽走兽早已逃得干干净净，别说猎物，连草根树皮，都快被挖尽了。”

话音未落，村外官道之上，又传来一阵哀号之声。众人转头望去，只见一群拖家带口的逃荒百姓，步履蹒跚而来。有人走着走着，双腿一软，直直栽倒在地，再也没能爬起。同行之人早已麻木，无力搀扶，只能含泪绕行，继续向前挪动。
白洁行至道旁，望着倒地不起的流民，俯身查看，已然气绝。她缓缓起身，吟诗叹惋：
content_en:
The poem says:
The beacon smoke has just stopped and the road is long, and the world is dry and cold.
Thousands of hectares of fertile fields are cracked with soil, and thousands of families are hungry and exhausted.
Everyone left Xiama Village and meandered westward. Along the way, I gradually felt that the ground was dry and hot, the wind was blowing dust, and there was no trace of rain or dew. Previously, there were green seedlings, weeds and gurgling streams beside the road. As we went further, the grass and trees became more and more withered and yellow, and the rivers and ditches dried up day by day. Between heaven and earth, there is a sweltering heat and turbidity. Looking up, the distant mountains have lost their green color and the plains have turned yellow, giving off a faint air of chilling desolation.
He raised his hand to wipe away the fine dust on his forehead, looked at the dry scenery all over the field, frowned and said:
"Farewell to the war, the road is to the west, the sun is shining brightly and there are few clouds.
There is no green color in the fields, and the disaster atmosphere has covered the wild embankments.
Having just gone through the war, I hoped that the countryside would be peaceful, but unexpectedly something strange happened again. It was so hot and sunny for a long time, and it was probably a severe drought. "
Bai Jie stopped and leaned down, stretched out her hand to touch the dry and cracked soil under her feet. The soil was as hard as stone, and turned into fly ash with a twist, and softly recited:
“The soil is cracked with thousands of stripes and no grass can grow, and the long rivers have stopped flowing and the water is pouring.
The sky has been stingy with rain for a long time, how can thousands of households survive?
Military calamities hurt people, but there is still room for disaster; natural disasters come to the world, and everything in the world suffers together. The rivers are drying up, the fields are cracked, and the crops are harvested. Even if you have gold and silver, you can't even get a mouthful of food. This calamity is even more dangerous than weapons. "
He Yue closed her eyes and concentrated on observing the energy of the sky and the earth. After a moment, she opened her eyes and her expression became more solemn: "For hundreds of miles, the clouds are cut off, the rain veins have disappeared, and there has been no rain for several months. The drought has deepened, and the surrounding villages must have run out of food and water, and they are in unspeakable suffering."
Gongsun Li looked at the continuous deserted village in front of him. All the smoke from the past was gone, and he sighed softly:
“I once lived in Yunque and looked at the mountains and rivers, and my eyes were filled with greenery.
Now that I encounter drought and evil on the dusty road, I realize that nature is also biased.
Man-made disasters can still be helped by human resources, but natural disasters are variables of heaven and earth. We, who have lost our magical powers, cannot call the wind and rain, or send clouds and rain. We can only accompany you in our mortal bodies and experience the suffering of hunger together. "
Huayue Trail: "After all the tribulations in the mortal world, human hearts and wars, there will be natural disasters of famine. Grain is the source of nourishment, and water and fire are the source of life. Once both are exhausted, the people will be in a desperate situation. What is tested here is the heart of compassion. Seeing all living beings starving and dying in the wild, if the Taoist heart is unmoved and compassion is completely lost, it will be difficult to achieve perfection in the Great Way."
The yellow weasel demon huddled on He Nian's shoulder, sniffed the dry wind with his small nose, and said timidly: "In the past, there were clear springs and wild fruits in the mountains, but now the grass and trees are all withered, and even the insects are gone. How can the people survive in such a situation?"
He Nian nodded slightly, his eyes were focused, and he said slowly: "There are four seasons in the sky, and there are also disasters and auspiciousness. Floods, droughts, winds and thunders are all determined by the reincarnation of heaven and earth. We have proclaimed ourselves as saints and do not violate the order of heaven. We cannot force rain to reverse the world. But when we see people who are hungry, we should try our best to help each other. If we can feed a meal, we will feed a meal, and if we can feed one person, we will feed another person. Let's go and look forward."
Everyone moved forward, but within a few miles, the scene before them was even more shocking.
But see:
The red land stretches for thousands of miles, and the deep ditches in the fields look like knife wounds.
All the fish and shrimps in the streams and rivers have bottomed out, and all the old trees have withered branches and leaves.
The doors of the shabby cottages were ajar, and hungry people lay beside the road along the way.
The sound of crying comes with the wind, and the eyes are full of desolation and heartbreaking.
On both sides of the official road, the fertile fields are full of cracks and ravines are deep enough to be embedded in the ground. The river that used to be rippling with blue waves is now only a bare river bed with exposed rocks and no water left. The ancient branches beside the road are dry and withered, and there is no trace of green. The villages are quiet, with few pedestrians walking around. Occasionally, there are a few weak cries, which are blown away by the wind, making it even more desolate.
When we arrived at the entrance of a village called Kushui Village, we saw a group of sallow-looking villagers sitting in front of the door in twos and threes. All of them were in ragged clothes, with sallow complexions, sunken eye sockets, and limbs as thin as firewood. They lacked the strength to even stand up and walk.
An old woman with white hair was holding on to the door frame, her breath was dying, and in her arms was a child who was so thin that he was just skin and bones. The child's eyes were closed tightly, and he was breathless, and he had fainted from hunger.
"water……Water..." The child's weak murmur made people's hearts tense.
The old woman burst into tears and choked with sobs and said to herself: "It's a damn drought...it hasn't rained for months, the wells have dried up, and the food supply has run out. The family has not eaten for several days, and my grandson may not be able to hold on..."
There were several middle-aged men nearby who used to be able to plow and plant, but now they were lying on the ground, weak and exhausted. They looked at the cracked fields and sighed, their eyes full of despair.
“No matter how hard it was in previous years, there was always a harvest, but now there is no harvest, and the stored grain has long been used up. The whole family, young and old, suffer from hunger every day. If they continue to endure it, the whole village may be buried in the loess. "
"I want to escape from the famine, but there is a severe drought everywhere. No matter where I flee, it is the same. I can't walk or escape, I can only wait here to die..."
The yellow weasel demon's eyes were red and he covered his mouth with his little paws: "It's so pitiful... He doesn't even have a mouthful of water or a mouthful of food. This life is even more difficult than suffering in the Demon Abyss. Immortal Master, let’s think of a solution quickly! "
Heri strode forward, squatted down to check on the unconscious child, then looked at the hungry people around him, and sighed:
“The fertile soil and fertile fields turned into sand, and the people were hungry and in chaos.
If the sky does not sprinkle three thirds of rain, it will be in vain to teach the common people to lose their years.
Dear fellow villagers, are there any remaining water sources or some wild animals around this place? Sitting still and waiting for death is not an option after all. "
A middle-aged man shook his head slowly and said in a hoarse voice: "I don't know what I know. There are dozens of miles around and there are no wells or rivers. Where can there be running water? The grass and trees in the mountains are withered, and the birds and animals have long since escaped. Not to mention the prey, even the roots and bark of the trees have been dug up. "
Before he finished speaking, another burst of wailing came from the official road outside the village. Everyone turned around and saw a group of fleeing people, dragging their families and families with them, staggering towards them. Some people were walking, and their legs gave way, and they fell straight to the ground and could not get up again. The people walking with him were already numb and unable to support him, so they could only walk around with tears in their eyes and continue to move forward.
Bai Jie walked to the side of the road and looked at the refugees who had fallen to the ground. She leaned over to check and found that she was already dead. She stood up slowly, chanted a poem and sighed:
